result: Fixed win-based weighted portfolio did not improve over MOEA/D in this development pilot
scope: Six development bases and three master seeds; same bases used to derive prior weights; no confirmation or test data accessed; historical runs not pooled
seed_caveat: Current individual and portfolio arm streams match by derived seed; these streams differ from the older source campaign used to derive weights
interpretation: Favors moving on from this fixed quota as an improvement candidate; does not establish that all weighted allocations or all portfolios fail
next_step: Design a dynamic budget redistribution pilot before adding cooperation or changing several mechanisms at once
